title: Validation Basics
description: Learn how to validate input data in ASP.NET Core Web API.

data.text: **Input validation** is crucial for building secure and reliable APIs. ASP.NET Core provides built-in validation attributes and mechanisms.

data.title: Validation Attributes
ModelState
data.text: ASP.NET Core automatically checks ModelState.IsValid in API controllers when using [ApiController] attribute.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use data annotations for validation rules
Return 400 Bad Request for invalid models
data.takeaway: Validation keeps your API data clean and secure.
